## Summary

Describe the user problem, changes, and non-goals. Link related issues where relevant.

## Compatibility and behavior

Describe affected presets/scenarios, compatibility, authorization boundaries, context impact, and any migration or rollout needs. State explicitly if none apply.

## Verification

List exact commands/results and distinguish automated tests, static instruction evaluation, and live fresh-session checks. Include limitations, skipped checks, or untested platforms.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read the contributing guidelines and code of conduct.
- [ ] Changes are focused and preserve applicable scope/approval and safety boundaries.
- [ ] I regenerated the preset artifact if shared sources changed and checked freshness.
- [ ] I ran the relevant tests and full suite, or explained why I could not.
- [ ] I updated affected documentation and scenario cases, or explained why not needed.
- [ ] No secrets, customer data, private `.gold/` records, or unredacted logs are included.
- [ ] Evidence is self-contained and does not depend on private local records.
